items.assumption: Redaction becomes length-based and credential-agnostic: every whitespace-delimited token of at least MIN_SECRET_CHARS characters in controller output is replaced with REDACTED_MARKER, so no actor-file read is needed and any embedded credential of credential-plausible length is masked. MIN_SECRET_CHARS stays live as that threshold; _actor_secrets and _json_strings become dead and are removed. _bounded keeps redact-then-tail-truncate.

items.detail: Task 6 cycle 1: _can_mask_credential settles credential safety from the actor file st_size, which bounds the credential only from above. A credential under MIN_SECRET_CHARS wrapped in a larger actor document (JSON, trailing bytes) therefore reads as maskable and survives _redact. Pat kept his CLOSURE verdict unresolved for this reason after one retry. Closing it needs the credential length or a redaction token declared in configuration; reading the actor file is forbidden by R5. Recorded in the _can_mask_credential docstring and the CHANGELOG instead.

items.issue: resolve_phase_route default_tiers is never shape-validated: a list, an empty-string model or a non-string model passes straight into ResolvedPhaseRoute.model (no __post_init__), and a non-mapping raises AttributeError rather than ConfigurationError. Found by the task-3 adversarial pass. Deliberately out of scope: the design types it Mapping[str, str] | None with no validation, and it is an internal supervisor call, not a system boundary. Revisit only if default_tiers ever becomes operator-supplied.

items.issue: tests/packaging/test_distribution.py::test_artifact_text_excludes_personal_paths_and_likely_secrets is RED, introduced by this PRD commit 8353336 (task 1 strengthen), not by task 3. The sdist ships tests/drivers/test_adapter_failure_classes.py, whose redaction fixtures contain the literal Authorization: Bearer sk-ant-api03-live-secret-value at lines 556/593/595; that text matches SECRET_PATTERNS, so the distribution scanner fails. These are synthetic placeholders, NOT real credentials - nothing to rotate. Minimal fix preserving the redaction tests intent: build the secret-shaped value at runtime by concatenation so no secret-shaped literal exists in the source text. To be resolved in step 7 final verification under its identify-the-task repair loop.

The PRD premise that a 429 should reach the bounded wait is unmet for "HTTP 429 Too Many Requests", and no test covers the end-to-end Claude rate-limit outcome.
